title: tarenna confusa
intro: Tarenna confusa, commonly known as the "Wild Jasmine", is a species of flowering plant in the family Rubiaceae. The Wild Jasmine is known for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various ailments, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Tarenna confusa include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
